import re

def parse_demo_pair(msg, n=30):
    lines=msg.splitlines()
    out={}
    for label in ('input','output'):
        idx=next(i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith(f'Demo pair') and f' {label} (' in l)
        grid=[]
        for line in lines[idx+1:idx+1+n]:
            vals=[int(x) for x in line.split()]
            grid.append(vals)
        out[label]=grid
    return out

def rule_apply(inp, source_rows, bands):
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    bg, source=comps(inp, source_rows)
    for col,cells,bbox in source:
        # clear source
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=bg
        if col not in bands: continue
        r0,r1,border=bands[col]
        br0,bc0,br1,bc1=bbox
        h=br1-br0+1
        dest_bottom=r1
        dr=dest_bottom-br1 # translation so source comp bbox bottom aligns with target panel bottom
        for r,c in cells: out[r+dr][c]=border
    return out
